closed: ∀ (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14)) (hdeg : ∀ v : Fin 14, 4 ≤ Nat.card (G.neighborSet v)) (hq : Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet ≤ 15), x2611_15358_D G ≤ 64 * Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet
original:
Let $G$ be a simple graph on fourteen vertices with minimum degree at least four, and suppose its complement $G^{c}$ has $q\leq 15$ edges.
Define

 $D=\sum_{\begin{subarray}{c}U\subseteq V(G)\\
|U|=7\end{subarray}}\bigl(c(G[U])-1\bigr).$ 

Then $D\leq 64q$ .
